text:
You curl the rich waves of King Midas,
Lisi, precious in touch and just as greedy;
carnations burn in their bright circle,
blazing blood, splendid wounds.


Burning mines joined to a garden
are a miracle of love, a rare wonder,
when Hybla colors Parian marble
and sees flowers kindled in its hardness.


Those that on your noble head
are bloody beauty and an affront
to the rich, victorious mane,


give the cloister of pearls upon your lip
an eloquent ruby, lovely purple,
now a ringing carnation, now wise coral.

translation.title: A Lisi, que su cabello rubio tenía sembrados claveles por el cuello
